question: What is the name of the scheme under which the Government of India has planned to provide skill training for 2 crore women as announced in August 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakhpati Didi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lakhpati Didi** is the name of the scheme under which the Government of India has planned to provide skill training for 2 crore women as announced in August 2023.
 
• This initiative aims to empower women by enhancing their skills and providing them with better employment opportunities.
